[Verse 1]
I count the numbers on the street
A key, a map, a borrowed town
The pavement does not know my feet
I learn the bus routes upside down

[Pre-Chorus 1]
The windows glow but none of them say stay
I practice saying hello to the day

[Chorus]
Nobody knows my name here yet
I'm still a face they have not met
I've got a key, I've got a door
I set my suitcase on the floor

[Verse 2]
The market opens in the rain
I learn the tram stop, platform nine
The vendor asks my name again
And this time it comes out as mine

[Pre-Chorus 2]
I pin a photo to the wall
And wait for someone else to call

[Chorus]
Nobody knows my name here yet
I'm still a face they have not met
I've got a key, I've got a door
I set my suitcase on the floor

[Bridge]
Maybe someday this will all feel old
The corner shop will know my order
And when I say my name I'm told
It sounds like someone who belongs here

[Chorus]
Nobody knows my name here yet
I'm still a face they have not met
I've got a key, I've got a door
I set my suitcase on the floor
